title: Tone of voice – ‘Engaging, curious, enjoyable, respectful’
slide_intent: Show writers how to adjust the emphasis of four voice qualities for the subject, venue and speaker while keeping a recognizable shared tone.
strategic_value: The six museums can share a verbal identity while preserving differences between venues and clearly attributing an artist or community member’s words.
demonstration: Four text columns move from purpose and audience to a list of characteristics and guidance on how strongly to use each one.
practical_value: Decide who is speaking and which qualities should lead for this audience. Use the four terms to review the copy after drafting.

content_islands.name: Purpose and audience
content_islands.spec: Place the introduction, application and intended writers in the left-hand columns. Use short colored subheads to distinguish each job.

content_islands.name: Personality and four qualities
content_islands.spec: In the next column ask how the brand would speak as a person, then list the four characteristics.

content_islands.name: Balancing the voice
content_islands.spec: Use the right-hand column to explain adjusting relative emphasis by medium. Close with the emphasized checklist prompt.
